steps.user_message: Can you help me coordinate a virtual team building activity with our department heads, Sarah, John, and Rachel, on Thursday, September 9th at 3:00 PM to boost morale and teamwork?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Can you help me coordinate a virtual team building activity with our department heads, Sarah, John, and Rachel, on Thursday, September 9th at 3:00 PM to boost morale and teamwork?
steps.agent_response:
Yes — I can help coordinate that. Before I start drafting or sending anything, a few quick questions so I set it up exactly how you want:

1) Confirm date/time & time zone — you said Thursday, September 9 at 3:00 PM; is that your local time (and which time zone)?  
2) Duration — how long should the session be (30 / 45 / 60 / 90 minutes)?  
3) Platform — Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, or another? Do you want me to include a link (if you want me to send the invite I can ask them to add it or include your meeting link)?  
4) Facilitator — do you want to facilitate, have David or Megan run it, or hire an external facilitator?  
5) Format & goals — preference for icebreakers, problem-solving activities, or skills/teamwork exercises? (I can propose a few.)  
6) Budget or materials — do you want any paid activities/prizes or do you prefer free options? Any supplies needed (gift cards, breakout-room prompts)?  
7) Invite list & recipients — confirm attendees (you said department heads Sarah, John, Rachel — include anyone else or assistants?) and whether to CC anyone.  
8) RSVP & prework — want RSVP deadline or any prework (short survey or one-sentence prompt to prepare)?

- Quick icebreaker + breakout brainstorm (45–60 min): Short warm-up, then small breakout teams solve a fun challenge related to work; regroup and debrief. Good for idea generation and energy.
- Virtual escape room (60 min): Facilitated, turns teamwork & communication into a game. Paid option but high engagement.
- Collaborative problem-solve (60 min): Present a real team challenge and use structured methods (SWOT/brainwriting) in breakout rooms — great for actionable outcomes.
- Mini workshops + reflection (90 min): Short micro-training (communication or feedback) then practice in pairs and group reflection.

Sample 60-minute agenda
- 0–10 min: Welcome & quick icebreaker
- 10–35 min: Breakout activity (3 groups) — focused challenge
- 35–50 min: Group share & synthesis
- 50–60 min: Action items & close

Agenda (high level):
- Quick icebreaker
- Breakout teamwork activity
- Group share and action items

Please RSVP by [date], and let me know if you have any preferences for activities or accessibility/dietary needs for any follow-ups. I’ll send the meeting link and materials once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to it,  
[Your name]

What would you like me to do next?
- Draft and send the invitation now (tell me who to send from and whether to CC anyone), or save as a draft
- Propose a specific activity and I’ll create facilitator notes and breakout prompts
- Book an external facilitator and request quotes (I can draft emails to vendors)
- Save this event to your memories so I’ll remind you later

Tell me your preferences for the numbered questions and which next action you want. I’ll draft/send and handle follow-ups.
